events.detail_full_main: 10:47頃、JR神戸線内での踏切内点検の影響で、姫路〜網干駅間の一部列車に遅れが出ています。
events.detail_full_zh: 10:47左右，因JR神户线内铁路道口检查，姬路至网干站之间的部分列车出现晚点。
events.detail_full_en: Around 10:47, some trains between Himeji and Aji Station are experiencing delays on the JR Kobe Line due to an inspection being conducted within a level crossing.
